generation.prompt_exact:
Create a production sprite sheet for ChirpNeighbors: EXACTLY FOUR distinct isolated placeable backyard objects in a strict 2 by 2 grid on a fully transparent alpha background, each entire object and its small contact shadow inside its own quadrant, with generous clear gutters and margins. No labels, text, numbers, panel borders, swatches, scenery, birds or plants. All four are detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with visibly crisp square pixel clusters, restrained rich texture and soft earthy shading, subtle dark contour, consistent three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility, warm upper-left sunlight. Not cartoon/chibi, no glossy vector surfaces, no photorealism, no UI. Calm handcrafted realism where birds can remain focus.
TOP LEFT: handsome cedar hopper bird feeder on a single square weathered wooden post and a low unobtrusive simple footing. Broad peaked shingle roof, transparent seed hopper with golden seed, narrow open seed tray with an accessible front and side perching edge, realistic cedar joinery. Entire roof, post and ground contact included.
TOP RIGHT: low cedar platform feeder, rectangular shallow open seed tray on four very short legs, slatted floor and raised perimeter lip, a few golden seeds in tray. No roof, no post, no chains. Entire object and all legs visible.
BOTTOM LEFT: hanging red glass nectar feeder, small translucent ruby-red reservoir bottle with charcoal hanging hook, red circular feeding base with four simple yellow-rimmed ports and tiny red perching arcs. No flowers, no birds, no stand. Entire hook to base visible, no branding.
BOTTOM RIGHT: broad weathered cedar garden bench, slatted seat and slatted gently curved back, modest armrests, two sturdy paired legs and visible joinery, warm gray-brown wood grain, approximately 1.4 meters wide, inviting simple craft. No pillows, plants or extra accessories.
Four individual objects only; no added decorations. Match coherent realistic relative material scale but give each quadrant a useful large sprite. Transparent outside silhouettes; no white/checkerboard backdrop. These are flattened still candidates, not an animation.
